_comment: Frozen 2026-08-18 from champollion.db source_licenses (318 rows) ahead of that store's retirement. These are HUMAN-VERIFIED license claims and prose (attribution strings, sovereignty scoping notes, permission states) that have no atlas home — the atlas cldf_sources carries SPDX + flags per pinned release, never the hand-written attribution/notes. build-shared-licenses.mjs consumes this as a FLOOR: an entry here may be TIGHTENED by newer evidence but never silently loosened; loosening requires explicit per-source founder acceptance (--accept-license-changes --source <id>). sha256 of the source db recorded in the retirement commit.
